tools.npm:
case "$1" in
create)
  mkdir -p src/client src/server src/shared
  echo '{"name":"made","scripts":{"build":"rbxtsc","watch":"rbxtsc -w"}}' > package.json
  echo '{"compilerOptions":{"rootDir":"src","outDir":"out"}}' > tsconfig.json
  echo '{"name":"made","tree":{"$className":"DataModel"}}' > default.project.json
  : > src/client/main.client.ts; : > src/server/main.server.ts; : > src/shared/module.ts ;;
pkg)
  printf '{"scripts":{"build":"%s","watch":"%s"}}\n' "${3#scripts.build=}" "${4#scripts.watch=}" > package.json ;;
esac
